card.title: FRONTIER FORCE

card.flavorText: The 12th Frontier Force Regiment was formed in 1922 as part of the British Indian Army. During WWII the regiment was raised from 5 regular battalions to 15 battalions and saw service in East Africa, North Africa, the Middle East, Italy, India, Malaya and Burma.The 1st battalion served in Iraq and Syria before it was sent to fight in the Italian Campaign on 24 September 1943. The 2nd battalion fought during the Battle of Malaya until it was forced to surrender with the rest of the Allied forces in Singapore on 15 February 1942. The 3rd battalion was part of the 5th Indian Infantry Division and served in East Africa and the Western Desert Campaigns. The 4th battalion served throughout the war in the Burma Campaign, while the 5th battalion was on garrison duties in Iraq as part of the 6th Indian Infantry Division. The Regiment's casualties in the war totalled 1,444 dead and 3,503 wounded.
